name: Firsto

sources.title: Homepage — 'Agent Index': product launch platform with public APIs, MCP tools and llms.txt
Pricing — Free (queue ~180 days, 5 slots/day, DF backlink only for Top 3 with badge), Premium $19.9 (24h), Pro $59.9 (2-week homepage feature + mini review)
llms.txt — launch types, 8:00 AM UTC daily launches, public discovery API

conditions: Free Launch exists but the queue is ~180 days with only 5 free slots daily
Free tier's dofollow backlink requires landing Top 3 AND embedding their badge
Premium $19.9 launches in 24h with a guaranteed DR59+ dofollow backlink
Account sign-up required (Sign in / Sign up on the site)
The catalogued submission URL /projects/submit returned 404 on 2026-09-25 — the live entry is the 'Submit a Project' nav link
requirements: Startup/SaaS/AI tool or digital product to launch
Registered account; launches happen daily at 8:00 AM UTC
Free tier badge requirement for the dofollow backlink (embed from the project page)
preparation: Product name, tagline, URL, logo, categories/tags, pricing info, description (Markdown supported)
Pick plan: Free (~180-day queue) / Premium $19.9 (24h) / Pro $59.9 (adds 2-week homepage feature + written mini-review)
Optional review add-ons: Public Review $199, Private Review $299, Full Package $399
workflow: Use 'Submit a Project' (nav) and fill the project form
Select a launch plan and a launch date from the plan's availability
Project launches at 8:00 AM UTC and joins daily/weekly/monthly voting
Every submission gets a permanent project page at /projects/<slug> (with an /llm markdown variant) — discoverable via API and search engines
watchFor: Free queue is ~180 days — do not promise a date on the free plan
Free-tier dofollow link is doubly gated: Top-3 ranking AND badge embed
Premium/Pro prices are per-launch one-time fees; review packages are separate large upsells ($199–$399)
Unusually agent-friendly: public API, MCP endpoint, llms.txt — programmatic discovery is encouraged but submission itself needs an account
Note: /projects/submit 404'd at research time — use the 'Submit a Project' nav link instead
countsAsLive: Product has a public page at firsto.co/projects/<slug> and appears in /launches with its launch date and vote count
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the account wall
Whether the free tier's badge is verified automatically
